task: Constrain ultralight boson (ULB) properties via black hole superradiance
methodological_commitments: Bayesian statistical framework (not frequentist point estimates)
Ingest full posterior distributions of BH mass and spin
Black hole superradiance physics: gravitational atom analogy
Superradiance rate computation using Detweiler/Arvanitaki formulas
Critical spin curves (Regge trajectories) for exclusion regions
Upper limits on self-interaction coupling strengths (decay constant f_a)
Apply to both stellar-mass (M33 X-7) and supermassive (IRAS 09149-6206) BHs
named_methods: Non-relativistic superradiance rate formula (Eq. 18 of Arvanitaki et al. 2011)
Bosenova collapse criterion for self-interaction constraints
data_sources: M33 X-7 posterior samples (Liu et al. 2008)
IRAS 09149-6206 posterior samples (Shangguan/GRAVITY 2020 + Walton et al. 2020)
target_quantities: Upper limits on self-interaction coupling f_a (GeV)
